passes.title: Lantern charge in 6 seconds
passes.desc: The L1c lantern charge (ring fist pushed into the lantern's port) squeezed into 6 seconds, with three ways to split the time between filling, overcharging and letting go.

takes.name: L1c charge, C6a timing
takes.facts: fill 4 s (ticks 9-90), overcharge 1 s (90-110), let-go 0.5 s (110-120); 120 ticks total, idle glow 0.12 before/after

takes.name: L1c charge, C6b timing

takes.name: Primed flight slam (shift)
takes.facts: locked at tick 18, lands tick 30, 7x7 crater opens at once, lining 3 s, rebuild ripple from your look at tick 70

takes.name: Primed super-jump slam (crouch)
takes.facts: super jump to 24 blocks, locked head-down tick 40, lands tick 56, 9x9 instant crater, rebuild follows the crosshair sweep

takes.name: Unprimed slide
takes.facts: lands tick 30, slides 5 blocks on one knee, trench 3 wide x 6 long, lining one block out all round for 2 s

passes.desc: Five green particle-wall designs (curtain, lattice, swarm, rising embers, shards) rebuilt in a small scene so J can finally see them.
